subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II report request + trust portal provisioning for HarborPay
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@harborpay.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II report request + trust portal provisioning for HarborPay

Alex — thanks for your time today. Quick recap and next steps from our call so we have alignment on the security artifacts HarborPay needs to complete procurement.

Key points from the call:
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II for the period Jan 1 2026–Dec 31 2026 (attestation in progress for 2027; see note below).
- We support GDPR and HIPAA workloads; we are willing to sign a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and execute standard BAAs where required.
- Subprocessors and data flow details can be provided via our trust portal.

What you asked for:
1) Copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or interim evidence if report is delayed).
2) A bridge/interim attestation confirming controls coverage through the current quarter.
3) Access to our trust portal for secure evidence upload and a short vendor security questionnaire (DSQ) so your security team can authorize us.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- I can provision HarborPay a limited-access folder in our trust portal. Please upload the completed DSQ and any additional forms there by Aug 18 to keep procurement on schedule. Link & instructions below.
- I attached a short bridge-letter template (redwood_bridgeletter_template.pdf) — we'll sign and return once legal confirms final language.
- Mina (cc'd) will handle the questionnaire and can provide the subprocessor list and retention details.

Portal link and instructions (temporary invite): https://trust.redwoodinference.com/invite/harborpay-HP-0042
Attachment: redwood_bridgeletter_template.pdf (sample bridge attestation)

If you prefer, I can also provide a redacted SOC 2 report and the 2026 Type II PDF after we complete a non-disclosure step — let me know your preference.

Thanks — aiming to keep this simple so procurement can move quickly.

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Email: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0191

From: Alex Rivera <alex@harborpay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@harborpay.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II report request + trust portal provisioning for HarborPay

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the summary. A few quick clarifications before we upload:

1) Timeline: HarborPay needs either the full SOC 2 Type II PDF or a signed interim attestation (bridge letter) by Aug 20 to make our August security committee. Will the bridge letter be signed by your compliance lead or legal?
2) Redaction: We typically accept a redacted report (remove tenant/customer-specific details). Is that something you can provide?
3) Data retention & logs: our compliance team wants confirmation of log retention length and whether logs can be exported in an encrypted form for our audit.
4) Subprocessors: Please include the current list and whether any subprocessors process EU personal data.

For the DSQ, what's your preferred format — we have a short one (excel) and our security team can fill an online shared form. Either works for us.

If you can get the bridge letter signed by Aug 19 and portal access before EOD tomorrow, we can keep the timeline.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Procurement, HarborPay
alex@harborpay.com

Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II report request + trust portal provisioning for HarborPay

Alex — thanks, we can meet that timeline. Quick replies inline and steps below.

1) Bridge letter signing: we'll provide a bridge/interim attestation signed by our Head of Compliance (Marissa). I've attached the signed stub template for your review. Marissa, can you confirm you'll sign the final?

2) Redacted report: yes — we can provide a redacted PDF of the 2026 Type II report. We'll remove customer-identifying attachments and redact IP that would be sensitive. If HarborPay needs specific sections (e.g., CC6 controls detail), note that in your upload so we can prioritize.

3) Log retention/export: Redwood retains request logs and audit traces for 365 days by default; we can provide encrypted exports on request for audits. Mina, please include exact retention policy and export steps in the portal folder.

4) Subprocessors & EU data: Mina will attach our subprocessors list and flag any that handle EU personal data. We also have a current DPA template that we can start from.

Portal provisioning: I created a HarborPay-only workspace and sent an invite to alex@harborpay.com and security@harborpay.com. Access link (temporary): https://trust.redwoodinference.com/invite/harborpay-HP-0042
Upload path: /HarborPay/Procurement/Redwood-Evidence
Notes: We accept the DSQ as an Excel or direct form upload. Please place the filled DSQ in the upload path and flag any questions in a short readme.txt.

Attachments included in this message: redwood_bridgeletter_template.pdf (signed-stub), portal-upload-instructions.txt

Next steps (owner in parentheses):
- HarborPay to upload DSQ and confirm required redaction scope (Alex) — target Aug 18.
- Marissa to sign final bridge letter and upload signed PDF (Marissa) — target Aug 19.
- Mina to upload subprocessors list + retention/export steps (Mina) — target Aug 12.

Forwarding the signed stub below so security sees the exact language we intend to sign.
